approval_status.description: The seller's review outcome. The seller moves it

asset_id.description: Identity of the asset within the line item

built_by.description: Which side built it. Absent: the buyer

format_id.description: The `formats.available[]` id the asset is for

url.description: Where the asset is, such as a tag URL with its macros unexpanded

content_digest.description: Over the exact bytes served at `url`

disclosure_methods.description: How the content is marked or disclosed. Core terms: `c2pa_manifest` | `watermark` | `audible_notice` | `visible_label`. A receiver that doesn't know a term reads that method as unstated

model_version.description: The version of the model that generated it

synthetic.description: True when the content is artificially generated or manipulated, in whole or in part

voice_consent_ref.description: The consent of the person whose voice is synthesized

method.description: Core terms: `buyer_hosted` | `seller_hosted` | `api` | `platform_managed`, defined in the creative path below

other_protocols.description: How a creative that list has no code for is delivered. Core term: `javascript_tag`, a tag whose script renders the ad. A receiver that doesn't know a term treats only that term as unavailable

protocols.description: Values from AdCOM 1.0 List: Creative Subtypes - Audio/Video the seller accepts, wrappers included, such as VAST 4.2 (13). The values OpenRTB 2.6 `video.protocols` and `audio.protocols` carry

secure_required.description: Whether the creative must load over a secure connection. Absent: this line item states no such requirement

spec.description: The full specification. OpenProposal does not hardcode a shape per channel

spec_ref.description: The format registry entry the spec comes from. Absent when the seller defines it

FormatsSelection.description: A field the buyer sets by choosing options from the set the seller declares. `included[]` names the options in the base rate, `selected[]` the buyer's choice, which replaces it, and `deltas` the price of each option outside `included[]`, each by option id.

deltas.description: The price of an option outside `included[]`, keyed by option id. An option with no entry has no delta.

included.description: The options in the base rate, by option id.

max_select.description: The most options that may be in effect.

selected.description: The buyer's choice, by option id. It is the complete set in effect and replaces `included[]`.

before_start.description: The deadline, as a length of time before `commitment.flight.start`

ProductionSelection.description: A field the buyer sets by choosing options from the set the seller declares. `included[]` names the options in the base rate, `selected[]` the buyer's choice, which replaces it, and `deltas` the price of each option outside `included[]`, each by option id.

deltas.description: The price of an option outside `included[]`, keyed by option id. An option with no entry has no delta.

included.description: The options in the base rate, by option id.

max_select.description: The most options that may be in effect.

selected.description: The buyer's choice, by option id. It is the complete set in effect and replaces `included[]`.
